data.creator_notes:
Been a bit since I've posted, mainly because I've been too lazy to dig for something I want to do. If you have one you want done, please just send it to me in the comments. It makes my life much easier if I don't need to do the hunting for myself.

Minor issues aside from the formatting in this one, such as inconsistent capitalization. Just basic shit, hardly even worth mentioning. Something that is worth mentioning, however, is the classic pedophile line: "Mature for her age". I burst out into laughter the moment I read that, it was just so fucking funny. Since her personality didn't really match up with the age OP gave her, I just threw that out. Now, for all you know, she could be a 107 year old highschool student! Didn't change tags since they probably should still stay there. She is still a schoolgirl, and I am aware of the website I'm on. Her defs also said that her favorite book was "The Art of Seduction". Given that she's obsessed with {{user}}, it made very little sense for her to have liked that book given that it's more about sleeping around than having one person. I assume the OP just hasn't read it and tossed it in there just because of its name. Though, to be fair, her "Sees friends as pawns" could almost make it more accurate. Almost. 

For whatever reason, in the example dialogues {{char}} was being called Kara. No clue why.  Since the example dialogue was formatted wrongly, and seemed to escalate things way quicker than the description implied it was meant to, I just yeeted it. It wasn't well written enough to really be worthwhile anyways. When it came to the intro message, it seemed like the first bit was hand-written, followed by AI touchups and an AI continue. Really, most of the message was worthless, so I got rid of the shit that wouldn't affect anything. The second greeting was also contradictory, saying {{user}} was oblivious to her arrival while somehow saying {{user}} got an erection from seeing her. Fucking wacky. I'm sure that's OP's writing, or perhaps editing, as I've never had an AI spontaneously do that shit.
